name: application-stat-comparison-bars
title: Stat Comparison Bars
description: Horizontal category comparison bars with value labels and an optional highlighted row, driven by a typed rows prop contract.
useWhen: Comparing a small set of categories (traffic sources, regions, plan tiers) by a single numeric value.
A compact dashboard card needs a ranked bar comparison without the overhead of a full charting library.
One row (e.g. the current user's segment or the top performer) should stand out from the rest.
avoidWhen: You need axes, legends, or multiple data series — use a proper chart component instead.
There are more than a handful of categories — a scrollable table communicates dense rankings better than stacked bars.
Precise value comparison matters more than relative proportion — a table with sortable columns is more precise.
responsiveBehavior: Each row's bar track spans the full card width; the card itself is a single block meant to sit in your own dashboard grid or sidebar.
accessibility: Every bar is paired with an explicit numeric value label — the bar length is a visual reinforcement, not the only source of the number.
The highlighted row uses both a background tint and bolder text, not fill color alone, to remain distinguishable.
Bar tracks and fills use sufficient contrast against their card background independent of the highlighted state.

variants.title: Stat Comparison Bars
variants.description: Ranked category bars with a value label per row, proportional bar fills, and one highlighted row with a tinted background.
accessibility: The highlighted row is set apart via background tint and bold text together, not fill color alone.

variants.title: Stat Comparison Bars (Dark)
variants.description: Category comparison bars adapted for dark surfaces with the same value-label, bar-fill, and highlighted-row structure.
accessibility: Bar track and fill colors must meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark card background.
